motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Consenting to the Transfer of Title to Property Located in the Boundary of the Interlocal of the New School District in West Utah County.
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Consenting to the Transfer of Title to Property Located in the Boundary of the Interlocal of the New School District in West Utah County with the following changes: 1. The language is changed from “purchase a new parcel” to “purchase a replacement parcel,” and 2. The consent is conditioned on the purchase of a replacement parcel for the elementary school. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.

The last sentence in 6.2.3 under Water Rights is removed; and 2. Instruct staff to continue negotiations with the developer to come up with a take- down schedule for the water, should the developer enter into the agreement
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, approving a Master Development Agreement for the Rose Ranch subdivision with the following conditions: 1. The last sentence in 6.2.3 under Water Rights is removed; and 2. Instruct staff to continue negotiations with the developer to come up with a take- down schedule for the water, should the developer enter into the agreement. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion. Discussion ensued to clarify the conditions of the motion.
